meta.title: Award more than the line's quantity
gaps: The required closed RFQ with bids from vendors A and B at 100 and 90 is not available in the prepared state, which has one bid and one vendor.
Allocate exactly 6 units to vendor B and 5 units to vendor A.
Observe the resulting refusal message that the awarded quantity exceeds the requested line quantity.
Open the event through the Events list and search its title; prepared-state cases must start with open_prepared.
